reviews.text:
I apologize for the delay in posting this review.

My Chihuahua had Grade 4 patellar luxation, and I was referred to this hospital by my regular veterinarian. I am extremely grateful for their care.

Since it's a hospital specializing in orthopedics, I felt confident entrusting them with the patellar surgery.

Although it's a long distance from Niigata, we managed to schedule appointments and made about five visits, including the initial consultation. The doctor, nurses, and reception staff were all very kind! I'm glad that she's recovering quickly!

Despite my many anxieties, Dr. Sasaki and the staff were incredibly kind and supportive.

She can now use her right hind leg properly, and I'm so glad we had the surgery. I'm truly grateful!

Finally, we received a cute graduation certificate with a photo. We've displayed it in our living room.

Thank you so much for everything.

My 6-month-old kitten suffered a tibial tuberosity avulsion fracture and underwent surgery. I sent a referral letter, and they made an appointment for me first thing the next morning, performing the surgery that same day. I was incredibly grateful for their prompt response during such an anxious time.

The phone calls before and after the surgery were also very reassuring.

I was amazed by her incredible recovery the day after the surgery—she was practically bouncing around!

Dr. Sasaki, the surgeon, as well as the receptionists and nurses, were all incredibly kind to her, and she never seemed scared during her visits!

She was able to graduate exactly two months after the surgery, and I was so happy to receive such a wonderful photo!

I'm almost sad that we won't need their services anymore... If I know any other pet owners in a similar situation, I would definitely recommend this hospital.

Thank you so much for saving my precious family member and helping her recover so well!

My beloved dog underwent surgery for a torn anterior cruciate ligament. I was worried about what would happen when he couldn't put weight on his leg, but he's now able to walk properly again. I am so grateful to Dr. Nakajo, the nurses, the physical therapists, and the reception staff for all their help over the past two months. I was also happy to receive a warm message card with a photo upon his graduation.

Dr. Mori is a brilliant orthopedic surgeon who offers hope for injured animals.

If Dr. Mori is still active during my lifetime,

if my dog ​​or cat suffers a serious injury again, I will undoubtedly ask Dr. Mori for help.

He is probably the best orthopedic surgeon in Japan.

However, the rehabilitation therapist, Mr. Kishi, is completely incompetent.

Perhaps it's because of our long acquaintance, but I think he should be observing how his colleagues conduct rehabilitation.

I think he should be paying more attention to how he earns the trust of pet owners.

They should bring in another veterinarian for rehabilitation.

No matter how sincere Dr. Mori's approach is, or how successful the surgery is, the rehabilitation is ruining everything.

My beloved toy poodle got its leg stuck in a road drain and fractured its radius and ulna. At 13 years old, it was a devastating blow, but my regular veterinarian recommended this clinic. They performed surgery under general anesthesia with only a two-night hospital stay, and it recovered smoothly, walking around happily again.

They kept me informed of its condition by phone before and after the surgery. Furthermore, they explained everything carefully at each follow-up visit, which put my mind at ease. I am truly grateful to Dr. Sasaki, the attending physician, and everyone at the clinic.

We received excellent care for our 2-year-old dog's intervertebral disc herniation surgery.

We were referred by our regular veterinarian, and the day after the onset of symptoms, a thorough examination and surgery were performed.

The doctor carefully explained the surgery, the future situation, and potential complications, which allowed us to entrust our dog to their care with peace of mind despite our anxieties.

After discharge, our dog was immediately placed in a partner rehabilitation center for rehabilitation, allowing for a smooth transition to rehabilitation. She has now recovered to the point where she can walk again.

She seemed to have received a lot of love and care during her hospital stay, and she was happy to see us at her post-operative check-ups.

At her final check-up, we received a cute postcard that looked like a graduation certificate, which made us very happy! ✨

This doctor is sincere towards animals and provides thorough medical explanations.

Although my pet was not a suitable candidate, I chose this doctor because of their extensive experience in treating cases involving bones and artificial ligaments.

My Toy Poodle is 8 months old.

This is my experience having surgery done at two different hospitals.

Previously, my dog ​​had surgery for a fractured left front leg at a different hospital. During the consultation, I waited in the waiting room while hearing heartbreaking cries. After the consultation, I was simply told that it was a fracture and needed surgery, without even being seen by the doctor.

The surgery was performed two days later, and a plate was inserted. However, after discharge, my dog ​​had difficulty walking and it took a long time for him to put weight on his leg. The scar is hidden by his fur, but a vertical line remains.

This time, I visited this hospital for a fractured right front leg. First, I was greatly relieved by the kind words, "Please don't blame yourself." I also had X-rays taken, and there were no cries, allowing me to wait with peace of mind. I was also relieved when they showed me his face before I left.

After the surgery, he was very energetic and walking on all four legs, which surprised me. The X-rays confirmed that it had healed beautifully.

I had to have the stitches removed at a nearby hospital because I was unwell, but the stitches were so clean that the scar is barely visible.

I felt a huge difference in service and skill, especially considering the same price!

I recommend them because they have high technical skills and reliable customer service.

We were referred here by the Yokohama clinic. Our pet suddenly became unable to walk, and we were filled with anxiety, but Dr. Sasaki took care of him, and his thorough explanations and kind treatment put our minds at ease. We also attended rehabilitation in Jiyugaoka, and now, two months later, he has recovered to the point where he is almost back to normal. We have received care from ONE Animal Orthopedics in Yokohama, Tokyo, and Jiyugaoka, and we are truly grateful to all the doctors and staff at all of them for their compassionate care of both us and our pets.

This is an excellent animal orthopedic hospital.

Our miniature dachshund developed lameness when walking at around 6 months old. We learned about this hospital through a referral from another veterinarian.

They were able to arrange surgery for the afternoon of our visit, which was incredibly helpful for us, as we had traveled a long distance to get there.

Before the surgery, the doctor explained the situation very carefully and gave us a detailed explanation of the possible complications that could occur after the operation.

Furthermore, we were able to take home all the bone X-rays on a CD.

Afterward, we had three follow-up checkups to confirm that the bone was recovering well, and finally, we received a very cute "graduation certificate."
